user.title: Add Philips air purifier
user.description: Enter the purifier's IP address. Give it a fixed IP or a DHCP reservation in your router so it doesn't move.

error.cannot_connect: The purifier didn't answer at this address. Check the IP and that it's powered on and on Wi-Fi.
error.wrong_device: A different purifier answered at this address.

deprecated_yaml.title: Philips AirPurifier YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Your `philips_airpurifier_http` fan configuration was imported into the UI. Remove the `fan:` entry with `platform: philips_airpurifier_http` from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant. To change the IP later, use Reconfigure on the integration.
